content: Rule of thumb: if only your own Next.js app calls the mutation, use a Server Action (form action prop, progressive enhancement without JS, type-safe, less boilerplate, colocated with the form). Use a Route Handler only when an external caller needs a stable HTTP contract (webhooks, third-party callbacks, mobile clients) or you need precise control over response headers/streaming. For a profile-onboarding form only used by the app's own UI, Server Actions are the better fit; existing waitlist/venues API routes can stay as Route Handlers since they're already built that way.
